data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED → GREEN (combined)

GAP FINDING (critical): SKILL.md prose is unexecutable — behavioral tests cannot run against it. Extract the Phase A draft PR creation logic into a testable helper script.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: post-Phase-A, gh pr list returns one draft PR with session branch as head and main as base
- DD3: Phase A blocks Phase E dispatch until PR creation completes

## What to create

### Script: plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh

Logic:
1. Require SESSION_BRANCH and PRIMARY_TICKET_ID env vars (exit 1 if absent)
2. Query existing PRs: `gh pr list --head "$SESSION_BRANCH" --state open --json url,isDraft,number --jq 'map(select(.isDraft == true))[0].url // empty'`
3. If existing draft PR found: echo the existing URL (idempotent reuse) and exit 0
4. Else: run `gh pr create --draft --base main --head "$SESSION_BRANCH" --title "Sprint: ${EPIC_TITLE:-sprint} (${PRIMARY_TICKET_ID})" --body "Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: ${PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}."` 
5. On success: echo the URL, exit 0
6. On gh failure: emit error to stderr, exit 1 (Phase A aborts)

### Tests: tests/hooks/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh

Use a gh stub (PATH-prepend a fake git stub) with modes controlled by env vars:

Given (case a — SPRINT_MODE=local): DSO_SPRINT_MODE not set, SESSION_BRANCH set
When: create-sprint-draft-pr.sh runs
Then: exit 0 (no-op when not in sprint mode) OR script should only be called by SKILL.md when SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr — validate the script exits 0 when no gh context without error

Given (case b — no existing PR): gh returns empty for pr list, gh pr create succeeds
When: create-sprint-draft-pr.sh runs with SESSION_BRANCH and PRIMARY_TICKET_ID
Then: exit 0, stdout contains PR URL

Given (case c — existing draft PR): gh pr list returns draft PR URL
When: create-sprint-draft-pr.sh runs
Then: exit 0, stdout is existing URL (no second gh pr create call)

Given (case d — gh pr create fails): gh returns non-zero
When: create-sprint-draft-pr.sh runs
Then: exit 1 (aborts Phase A, satisfies DD3)

## .test-index Update

Add:
`plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh:tests/hooks/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh [test_create_sprint_draft_pr_new_pr]`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Script handles idempotency (reuses existing draft PR, no duplicate creates)
- [ ] Script exits 1 on gh pr create failure (Phase A abort path)
- [ ] Script uses `// empty` in jq (not `// null`) to avoid 'null' string in bash
- [ ] Tests exist at tests/hooks/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh and are executable
- [ ] 4 behavioral test cases present (new PR, reuse existing, gh failure, missing env)
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for create-sprint-draft-pr.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
data.title: RED+GREEN: create-sprint-draft-pr.sh helper + behavioral tests
